test_title: PYST 66: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 2025, under which scheme did Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi distribute ₹5,000 crore to approximately one crore women?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhadra Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **February 2025**, the **Chief Minister of Odisha**, **Mohan Charan Majhi**, distributed the second phase of the first instalment of the **Subhadra Yojana**.
 
• A total amount of **₹5,000 crore** was transferred to the bank accounts of approximately **one crore women** beneficiaries across the state.
 
• The funds were distributed during a state-level program held on the auspicious occasion of **Saraswati Puja** (also known as **Basant Panchami**) in **2025**.
 
• This flagship welfare scheme was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on his birthday, **September 17, 2024**, to empower the women of **Odisha** economically.
 
• The distribution process utilizes **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** to ensure that the **financial assistance** reaches the intended beneficiaries without any middleman intervention.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Scheme Structure**: Under the **Subhadra Yojana**, eligible women receive a total financial assistance of **₹50,000** over a period of **five years**.
 
• **Annual Instalments**: Beneficiaries are provided **₹10,000** every year, which is divided into two equal instalments of **₹5,000** each. These are typically disbursed on **Rakhi Purnima** and **International Women's Day** (March 8).
 
• **Eligibility Criteria**: The scheme is designed for women in the **age group of 21 to 60 years**. It specifically targets those from **economically weaker sections** to enhance their **financial independence**.
 
• **Exclusions**: Women belonging to **economically well-off families**, **income tax payers**, and those receiving **government salaries** or pensions exceeding a certain threshold are generally excluded from this scheme.
 
• **Mission Shakti Comparison**: While **Mission Shakti** in **Odisha** focuses primarily on **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**, **Subhadra Yojana** acts as an individual-centric cash transfer scheme to provide direct liquidity to women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Digital Literacy and Incentives**: To promote the **Digital India** initiative, the **Odisha government** provides a **Subhadra Debit Card** to the beneficiaries. Additionally, an incentive of **₹500** is awarded to those who perform the maximum number of **digital transactions** in their respective **Gram Panchayats**.
 
• **Budgetary Commitment**: The **Government of Odisha** has allocated a massive budget of approximately **₹55,825 crore** for the implementation of this scheme over **five years** (from **2024-25** to **2028-29**).
 
• **Aadhaar Integration**: The scheme requires mandatory **e-KYC** and **Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts** to verify the identity of the beneficiaries and prevent **duplicate registrations**.
 
• **Nodal Agency**: The **Department of Women and Child Development** of the **Government of Odisha** serves as the primary body responsible for the execution and monitoring of the **Subhadra Yojana**.
